source.note: single-card witness of the bare EMIT stem `copy` (no supergroup) — a copy effect (CR 707). Live engine projects emit:copy (family=copy, stem=copy, manner=null, isSelf=false) for the activated ability '{T}: Create a token that's a copy of target nonlegendary creature you control, except it has haste. Sacrifice it at the beginning of the next end step.' This is the permanent token-copy variant (CR 707.2): CopyFamily.Recognize returns PortStructure.Of(Emit, "copy") — the AST CopyEffect (OracleEffect "copy", Target=nonlegendary creature you control, Modifications=[+haste]). The copy family is Stage-2 structured, so this is a faithful witness, not a wish. The permanent variant projects NO in-axis facets (the bare stem); the spell-copy variant (Dualcaster Mage / Reiterate, emit:copy:spell:instant+sorcery) adds resource=spell + a copied-type subject — `resource` is NOT in the closed attribute_axes set, so that facet is a taxonomy/axis decision surfaced separately, not authored here. No edhrec_rank in the testbed source (edhrec_rank=None) — popularity omitted (not fabricated).
